issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement (UML) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type int, while the provided solution implements public StudentCount getTotalNumberOfStudents() and adds a StudentCount class. This mismatch (int vs StudentCount) is present in the exercise specification (problem_statement.md) and the solution code (solution_repository). It will confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause compilation or test-signature mismatches if tests or templates expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to have getTotalNumberOfStudents() return an int (remove the StudentCount type). Concretely: (1) In solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, replace public StudentCount getTotalNumberOfStudents() with public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() and return (numberOfInscribedStudents + numberOfGuestStudents). Update callers in that file (e.g., getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents and getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to use the int return value. (2) Remove solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/StudentCount.java if no longer used. Alternative fix: if StudentCount is intentional, update problem_statement.md and the template to document the StudentCount type and provide its definition in the template so students implement against the same signature.
